transcript.statement: As EfficiencyAgent, I advocate for optimizing path planning (EFF-01) to reduce travel time, maintaining low jerk (EFF-02) for passenger comfort, and ensuring timely execution of Minimal Risk Maneuvers (EFF-03) without compromising performance. requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms.
The system shall execute Minimal Risk Maneuvers while integrating secure logging and energy-efficient protocols to ensure safety and data integrity.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue human takeover requests when boundaries are approached.
The system shall establish dynamic jerk limits during emergency maneuvers while complying with safety protocols.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints reliably.
The system shall optimize path planning to achieve a minimum 30% reduction in average travel time without compromising safety.
The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation to enhance passenger comfort.
The system shall achieve at least 95% success rate in optimal speed profile generation during path planning.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for all user data transmitted to protect privacy.
The system shall enforce role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their role.
The system shall conduct regular security audits at least bi-annually to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall ensure compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all operational times.
The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture that guarantees active monitoring and response to critical system failures.
The system shall document all safety and compliance-related decisions and changes for accountability and regulatory purposes.
